caseName: Akers ex rel. Lee v. Angelone
caseNameFull: Akers, by Lee, as Next Friend v. Angelone, Director, Virginia Department of Corrections

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.

Justice Stevens would grant the application for stay of execution.
